map.先去掉首尾空白；以反引号开头且以反引号结尾时直接取反引号之间的内容原样输出。否则: Trim the input; when it starts and ends with backticks, output the content between them as-is. Otherwise remove one pair of surrounding double or single quotes. Scan character by character: on a backslash with a following character, escape by the next character — a to bell, b to backspace, f to form feed, n to newline, r to carriage return, t to tab, v to vertical tab, backslash and single/double quotes to themselves; x takes the next 2 hex digits, u the next 4, and U the next 8, parsed as base-16 code points; when the next character is an octal digit, take up to 3 octal digits and parse as base 8; otherwise take the next character itself. Non-escape characters are kept as-is.
